Keep an eye out we’ll be revealing major updates [b]very soon[/b] through our new channels![/p][p]If you’re excited for monster evolution reveals, fresh gameplay footage, and deep dives into the lore… now’s the perfect time to join us.[/p][p]See you in [i]Summoner’s Tale[/i]![/p]
